title: lower: top-level user spec fns emit as bare 'spec fn' — a pub open spec fn (struct well_formed) naming one fails Verus privacy (E0425) -> correct source dies at L0; emit pub open spec fn for user spec fns (the REQ-8 visibility tier extended)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Critic re-audit (c116360c): diagnosis PARTIALLY confirmed. The privacy layer is REAL — hand verus on { bare spec fn s_dec + pub open spec fn well_formed calling it } rejects with 'in pub open spec function, cannot refer to private function' (NOT E0425), and the pub-open form verifies '1 verified, 0 errors'. But the LIVE E0425 on the Counter fixture has a different proximate cause: forge check's item_subprogram Struct arm builds the sub-program as the item ALONE, so s_dec is never in the emitted unit at all (and the param-type map is empty -> the cast regresses to as u64 per-item). Fixing this issue alone will NOT revive the fixture — see #232 (blocker) for the slicing layer + the pinned failing test.
